quantity: additive partisan fan-out in pp of scale range when the trust referent becomes climate-adjacent

leg_a_pew_w42.referent: medical -> environmental research scientists (5-item RQ4 battery, within person)
leg_a_pew_w42.source: inputs/measured/pew_atp_trust.json (recomputable from ATP_W42.sav; verified against the raw file to 0.01 pp)

leg_b_tisp_us.referent: scientists -> scientists in your country who work on climate change (same 5-point item, within person)

leg_c_gligoric2025.referent: climatologists vs 30 non-climate scientist types (4 types randomly assigned per respondent, two 1-7 trust items each), control arm
leg_c_gligoric2025.climatologists_rank: largest ideology gap of all 35 types (16.2 pp; environmental scientists 16.1; median type ~4.6)
leg_c_gligoric2025.not_used_for_the_adopted_value: SE 3.5 pp; pooling it moves the constant by 0.03 pp, below the resolution of anything downstream, so it is recorded as corroboration and every artefact stays on the two-leg value

pooled.method: inverse-variance over legs A and B (the two precise ones)

three_leg_value_not_adopted.why: leg C moves it by 0.01 pp

pooled.why_additive: TISP's generic ideology gap is 9.7 pp against Pew's 21.6, so a multiplicative stretch fitted in one source (2.07) does not transfer to the other (1.55) while the additive numbers agree (10.4 vs 11.8)
